title: Azt Javaslom, Hogy... – Giving Advice with hogy

sections.title: Advice inside a hogy-clause
sections.content: tanácsol and javasol ("to advise/recommend") both introduce advice with hogy ("that"), and the verb inside that clause takes the imperative form you already know — the same -j- pattern from the cooking unit, just now embedded in a sentence instead of standing alone as a command.

items.english: I suggest that you rest more.
I advise you to exercise regularly.

sections.content: Azt javaslom is a fixed opener worth memorizing whole — azt ("that", pointing forward to the hogy-clause) always comes first, then javaslom, then hogy plus the imperative.
